name: @projexlight/hdk-scanner
summary: Device-side barcode / QR / NFC / RFID scanner kit: capability negotiation per device + scan-event ingest with attestation. Powers ticket badge check-in (sdk-event), inventory pick-pack workflows, evidence chain-of-custody barcoding, and any 'tap to confirm' physical interaction.

endpoints.description: Return the active device's scanner capability matrix (camera-qr / hardware-laser / nfc / rfid).

events.name: hdk-scanner.scanned.v1
events.description: Scan-event committed; carries kind, value, device_uuid, geo.

events.name: hdk-scanner.duplicate.suppressed.v1
events.description: Duplicate scan within grace window suppressed (double-tap).

hooks.name: getCapabilities
hooks.description: Return scanner capability matrix for the device.

hooks.name: recordScan
hooks.description: Record a scan event; deduped within grace window.

scenarios.title: Door staff scans an event ticket QR
scenarios.when_to_use: Conference check-in (sdk-event); scanner records the scan + routes to sdk-event.checkInAttendee.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Scan event emitted. sdk-event consumer validates the ticket + records the check-in.

scenarios.title: Field tech barcodes an evidence bag
scenarios.when_to_use: Chain-of-custody — every evidence bag gets a barcode; the scan binds the bag to a capture in sdk-evidence.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Scan committed; sdk-evidence binds the bag identifier to the capture row.

scenarios.title: Mobile app queries capabilities to render UI
scenarios.when_to_use: App startup — if no NFC, hide the 'tap to confirm' button; if no hardware laser, fall back to camera-QR.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns capability matrix. Client UI adapts to whatever the device supports.

scenarios.title: Double-tap suppressed within grace window
scenarios.when_to_use: Operator scans the same QR twice within HDK_SCANNER_DUPLICATE_GRACE_SEC; second scan is silently dropped.
scenarios.example_code: // First scan → .scanned.v1. Second scan within grace → .duplicate.suppressed.v1 (no business effect).
scenarios.expected_outcome: Downstream consumers see exactly one effective scan. Audit chain has both events for diagnosis.

scenarios.title: NFC-tap attendance at restricted door
scenarios.when_to_use: High-security area; employees tap their NFC badge. Scanner verifies + emits scan event for security log.
scenarios.example_code:
// hardware NFC ring → recordScan({ kind: 'nfc', value: nfc_serial }).
// sdk-evidence + sdk-audit register the access.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Access logged. Audit chain answers 'who was inside the room at 14:23'.

compliance_posture.notes: Scan attestation chain via sdk-device. Duplicate suppression is a UX feature; both events retained for audit so a 5-min discrepancy can be diagnosed.
